item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00098","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C03","C05","C12"],"selected_candidate_label":"C03","confidence":0.94,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C03 supplies a concrete one-sentence template for granting a named individual an exception from competitive civil-service requirements: the same opening formula, individualized authorization, competitive-service context, and displacement of specified Civil Service Rules. C05 and C12 are nearly equivalent templates but refer more generally to noncompliance with the Civil Service Act and Rules, making C03's phrasing slightly closer.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"it is hereby ordered that the age requirements for entrance to examinations under the Civil Service Rules be, and they are hereby, waived to permit Otto K. Olesen to participate in the competitive civil-service examination","parent_excerpt":"it is hereby ordered that Mrs. Beth Campbell Short may be appointed to a permanent competitive position in the classified civil service of the United States without regard to the competitive provisions of the Civil Service Rules and Regulations","explanation":"Both are single-operative-sentence directives using the same opening formula to give a named individual a tailored exemption from Civil Service Rules governing competitive entry."}]}
